title: Pi Global STEM & Technology Pioneer Fellowship
description: Global merit scholarship for exceptional undergraduate and vocational learners pursuing Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI, and Blockchain Systems.
eligibilityCriteria: Enrolled in an accredited STEM or vocational tech program
Minimum CGPA 3.5/5.0 or high demonstrated engineering capability
Active Pi Network Pioneer Community Member

title: Federal Bilateral Education Agreement (BEA) Awards
description: Full international and domestic tuition sponsorship for outstanding secondary school graduates entering engineering, medicine, and physical sciences.
eligibilityCriteria: Minimum 5 A/B grades in WASSCE / NECO including Math & English

title: MTN Science & Technology Scholarship Scheme
description: Annual educational support grant for high-performing second and third year university and polytechnic students in science, technology, and applied sciences.
eligibilityCriteria: Second year (200L) or higher in public universities/polytechnics
Minimum CGPA of 3.5 out of 5.0 (or equivalent)

title: Early Years & Primary Equity Educational Grant
description: Subsidizes tuition, uniforms, and learning materials for low-income and vulnerable learners across accredited nursery and primary basic schools.
eligibilityCriteria: Enrolled in an accredited partner basic school
